drug_indication: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma, Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
catalyst_text: Announced positive initial combination data in solid tumors
detailed_catalyst_text: The company reported initial results from an ongoing Phase 1/2 trial evaluating the combination in MTAP-deleted and RAS-mutant PDAC and NSCLC. PDAC patients showed a 92% ORR with a 90% 6-month PFS rate and 100% disease control, while NSCLC patients had a 100% ORR; the regimen was generally well tolerated. These data indicate strong early antitumor activity and tolerability supporting further development.
catalyst_text_evidence: BOSTON, 2026-06-08 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tango Therapeutics, Inc. ... today announced positive initial data from its ongoing Phase 1/2 study of vopimetostat ... in combination with Revolution Medicines' RAS(ON) inhibitors in patients with MTAP-deleted and RAS-mutant metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). As of a data cutoff date of 2026-05-28, 59 patients with previously treated MTAP-deleted and RAS-mutant pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) or non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) were treated with a vopimetostat-based combination with either daraxonrasib ... In the vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib dose escalation arm ... Data highlights include: PDAC: 92% objective response rate (ORR) (11/12; 9 of 11 responses confirmed) 90% 6-month PFS rate 100% disease control rate (DCR) NSCLC: 100% ORR, 3 of 3 responses confirmed The vopimetostat + daraxonrasib was generally well tolerated across all dose levels with no new safety signals observed.

catalyst_text: Announced positive initial combination data in pancreatic cancer
detailed_catalyst_text: Initial Phase 1/2 data were reported for the combination in MTAP-deleted, KRAS G12D-mutant PDAC. Among response-evaluable patients, ORR was 52%, 6-month PFS rate was 74%, and disease control rate was 96%, with the regimen generally well tolerated. These findings show encouraging antitumor activity and safety for this targeted combination in pancreatic cancer.
catalyst_text_evidence: In the vopimetostat plus zoldonrasib dose escalation arm, patients with PDAC received vopimetostat 200 mg or 250 mg QD plus zoldonrasib 600 mg or 1200 mg QD. As of the data cutoff date of 2026-05-28, 27 patients were response evaluable with at least 14 weeks of follow-up. Data highlights include: 52% ORR (14/27; 10 of 14 responses confirmed) 74% 6-month PFS rate 96% DCR The vopimetostat plus zoldonrasib combination was generally well tolerated at all dose levels with no new safety signals observed.
